<p align="center"><strong>Find the song that opens the garden exit.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The brass key fits. Your cat pads into the attic and inspects the tea table without accepting an invitation.</p>

<p align="center">Three bells hang over the garden door: snowflake, sun and leaf. The ghost pours an extra saucer.</p>

<p align="center">&quot;One last puzzle before the garden,&quot; it says. &quot;Or one more cup.&quot;</p>
